grading: **Grading:** Fan-out strategy under time pressure; failure modes, retries, blast radius; scale math (RPS × bytes); time-efficient sketching — this is where candidates run out of time. Recent reports: FB Post Search (text search over a massive corpus).
prompts: **Prompts:** News feed fan-out + the **celebrity problem** (signature — scale a post seen by millions, separate hot/cold paths); **Ad Click Aggregator** (real-time ad clicks → billing); **Online Game Leaderboard** (real-time top-K, write-heavy); **Ticket Booking System** (atomicity under contention); **Top-K System** (heavy hitters); Product-Architecture: **Spotify Top-K Songs widget**, **Price Drop Tracker** (event-driven), **Instagram Auction**.

grading: **Grading:** Write-ups expected to map design decisions to **Leadership Principles** (Ownership, Dive Deep); failure scenarios and multi-region consistency; extensibility over pure scale; separate **LLD/OOD** round (Amazon Locker, Logger System, parking lot, elevator, library checkout, purchase-order filters, arithmetic expression tree) graded on SOLID/extensibility.
prompts: **Prompts:** CDN for media at scale; global file storage; distributed DB with global reach + regional failover; **Prime Day flash-sale traffic spikes** (burst absorption, queueing); parking/payment systems, warehouse robotics/fleet mgmt; Prime Video, WhatsApp, Twitter, Uber.
caveats: **Caveat:** Strongest signal at L4/L5; SDE III (L6) system-design depth under-represented in public data.

grading: **Grading:** Trade-off reasoning; scaling math under explicit growth assumptions; operational concerns (monitoring, rollout, rollback); the twist format from coding extends here — expect constraint changes mid-round. Hiring-committee packet matters: clear articulation beats cleverness.
prompts: **Prompts:** Google Search; YouTube (upload/serve at scale); Google Docs (collaborative editing); Google Maps (traffic/routing); Gmail, Drive, Chat, Photos, Meet; URL shortener; **web crawler**; news feed; distributed cache; rate limiter; notification system; distributed task scheduler; recommendation system; Ads auction.

grading: **Grading:** OOD/LLD is the senior separator — modular APIs, extensibility, SOLID; **privacy as a first-class design constraint** (encryption, data minimization, on-device processing); operational excellence (how it breaks at 3am); candidate questions probe *why* Apple (which product inspires you).
prompts: **Prompts:** Distributed **multi-vendor rate limiter** (candidate-reported); **iCloud-scale file storage** (candidate-reported); **Notes Sync for iCloud** (candidate-reported); guide-generated: Apple Maps, AirTag tracking, App Store, TinyURL, chess multiplayer, payment gateway with fraud detection, search engine, end-to-end encrypted messaging.
caveats: **Caveat:** No standardized loop — everything here is team-specific and thinly reported.

grading: **Grading:** **Verbal format — likely no diagramming** (60 min, one senior/staff engineer, talk through it); reasoning about blast radius, failure modes, and trade-offs out loud; reciting a memorized "design Netflix" answer is described as "a tell"; research the team beforehand — prompts track their current work. Most important round at Netflix per multiple sources.
prompts: **Prompts:** The team's **actual current problems** — e.g. "How would you design a dynamic recommendation system?" (profile-specific dynamic title categories); internal tooling: build-and-own event logging clients vs. document-and-let-teams-build (an unsolved problem the team was actively working through).

Tell me about a time you worked under a tight deadline.

Tell me about a time you made a mistake / received negative feedback — what did you change?
Tell me about the boldest decision you've made.
Tell me about a time you took ownership of a failure.
Tell me about a time you worked with a cross-functional team.
Tell me about a difficult stakeholder / convincing engineers to adopt your approach.
Tell me about a time you worked with ambiguous requirements.
Tell me about the most technically and people-challenging situation you've navigated.
Values-flavored variants (Move Fast, Be Direct): tell me about a time you shipped fast under uncertainty; a time you gave blunt feedback.
Tell me about a time you had to make a decision with incomplete data. *(Are Right / Bias for Action)*
Tell me about a time you disagreed with a teammate or manager. What happened? *(Have Backbone; Disagree and Commit)*
Tell me about a time you worked under a tight deadline. *(Deliver Results)*
Tell me about a time you went above and beyond for a customer / handled a demanding customer. *(Customer Obsession)*
Tell me about a time you dug into the details to solve a problem. *(Dive Deep)*
Tell me about a time you failed. What did you learn / what would you change? *(Learn and Be Curious)*

Full one-per-LP set documented in notes/amazon.md (Hire and Develop the Best, Ownership, Invent and Simplify, Insist on the Highest Standards, Think Big, Frugality, Earn Trust, Learn and Be Curious, Bias for Action, Are Right, Disagree and Commit, Deliver Results, Have Backbone, Dive Deep, Customer Obsession, plus the 16th).
